'''Nate Meeker''' won the [[2006 World Championship]] in Chicago, defeating [[Brian Hunter]].<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref>
